findings.governingReading: The active Japanese begins with Shirou’s internal recognition that firing would be useless; the voiced curse is commented out.
findings.explanation: The English restores deleted dialogue before his assessment.

findings.governingReading: The active Japanese page begins with “I can do nothing”; the repeated voiced curses are commented out.
findings.explanation: mirror moon restores the deleted outburst and additionally fuses its opening words.

findings.governingReading: A clipped impulse—“Run.”—breaks Shirou’s repeated paralysis before he tests the idea counterfactually.
findings.explanation: If I ran folds the impulse into the later hypothetical and removes the momentary self-command.

findings.highlight: running up to them and punching Berserker right now
findings.evidenceJa: 背中を向けているバーサーカーに殴りかかれば
findings.governingReading: Shirou reasons that if rushing the Berserker whose back is turned and punching him could save Saber, he would already have done it.
findings.explanation: Them introduces a plural destination and the English omits that Berserker’s back is turned, weakening the concrete opening Shirou judges insufficient.
